verdict.rationale: Sentry ships an official MCP server allowing AI agents to search errors, analyze performance, and query telemetry (sentry-docs-2, sentry-probe-3), plus a documented REST API for managing and exporting data (sentry-docs-14/20), OTLP ingestion for traces/logs (sentry-docs-8/25), and trace explorer for span queries (sentry-docs-9). Missing for 10: independent/hands-on third-party validation of the MCP server's debugging effectiveness and a discoverable OpenAPI spec (probe found 404s for openapi.json).
